'''Operation Midnight Freedom''' was the codename for a battle during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], which took place over the planet of [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]]. Six weeks prior, a Republic transport carrying soldiers and colonists went missing in the [[Fondor system/Legends|Fondor system]], having been captured by the Empire. After escaping their captivity, they were then fleeing imperial custody in a hijacked [[Imperial shuttle]]. An Imperial fleet was subsequently called in to destroy the shuttle in order to cover up the Empire's aggressive actions against the planet's populace, which were in violation of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. Calling for aid from the Republic, the conflict was resolved when all available forces in the region, including the [[Coruscant Aegis]] squadron, arrived, protecting the shuttle until it could be recovered a Republic [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]].<ref name="Fondor Escort" />

==Behind the scenes==
Operation Midnight Freedom appears as the Space Missions "Fondor Escort" available in the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Republic players are called to protect a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] from Imperial [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Bonus missions are available to destroy 25 Imperial fighters, 20 capital ship turrets, and a final mission to destroy the command point of a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]]. Operation Midnight Freedom is the Republic counterpart of the Empire's space combat mission [[Operation Silent Roar|"Jabiim Escort"]], which takes place above the planet [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]].<ref name="Fondor Escort" />
